caption:
Every day begins at a table like this: gallo pinto, plantain, warm tortillas and black coffee.

On our trail running week, this carries you through 17 kilometres across 9 summits on the spine of the Talamanca, or down the 25 kilometres of the Queen Stage into San Isidro de Dota. Where the trail leaves the roads behind, mountain families open their kitchen doors with fresh fruit, agua dulce and empanadas.

We keep each group to 6 to 8 athletes, sleeping in family lodges and eating what these valleys grow.

The Trail Running Expedition. Departures: 5 – 13 December 2026, 20 – 28 February 2027, 7 – 15 August 2027. Details in the bio.
